#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised

You: Golden crown is ok too! Don’t worry about it!
Lady Annalie: That’s not what I meant. I liked the cuffs more from the beginning, but because you chose them now I’m not so sure…
I hate it here…
